## About
At Total Bodywork Chiropractic, our goal is simple: help you feel better, move better, and live better. Whether you're dealing with back or neck pain, muscle tension, joint stiffness, headaches or sciatica, or you're looking for prenatal chiropractic care, we're here to support you every step of the way.
Every treatment plan is tailored to the person in front of us. We focus on relieving pain, restoring function and supporting long-term health, and we take the time to explain what we're doing so you can take an active role in your own well-being.
You'll find us on El Camino Real in Clear Lake, serving neighbors in Clear Lake and Webster. Patients mention Dr. Tovar, Dr. Price and Amanda at the front desk by name, and the practice holds a 5 rating from 20 Google reviews.

## Services
- Chiropractic Adjustments: Hands-on adjustments to relieve pain and help your body move the way it should, for back and neck problems, headaches, sciatica and joint pain.
- Pregnancy Care: Specialized prenatal chiropractic care for the aches that come with pregnancy. One reviewer came to Dr. Tovar for back pain late in her pregnancy.
- Massage Therapy: A Registered Massage Therapist on staff, proficient in shiatsu, acupressure, pre-natal, deep tissue, Swedish, sports therapy and more. Sessions are by appointment only.
- Acupuncture: Very thin, solid needles used to help relieve pain and support healing. Call the office to set up a consultation and exam.
- Electrical Muscle Stimulation: Used alongside adjustments to ease sore, tight muscles.
- Cervical Traction: Gentle traction for the neck as part of your treatment plan.
- Therapeutic Exercises: Exercises to help you rebuild strength and keep the progress you make in the office.
- Post-surgical Rehab: Rehabilitation support to help you recover function after surgery.

## FAQ
Q: What are your office hours?
A: Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday from 9:30 AM – 12:00 PM and 3:00 – 5:00 PM. The office is closed Thursday through Sunday.

Q: What kinds of problems do you help with?
A: Back and neck pain, muscle tension, joint stiffness, headaches and sciatica, along with specialized care such as prenatal chiropractic.

Q: Do I need an appointment for massage therapy?
A: Yes. Massage sessions are available by appointment only, so please call ahead to set up a time.

Q: Where is the office?
A: We're at 17045 El Camino Real, Suite 108, in Houston, serving the Clear Lake and Webster communities.
